name: proto-blocks/oit-form
title: OIT Form
description: Embeds a HubSpot form by ID inside the brand dark callout container, styled to match the OIT design. The HubSpot embed script is loaded once per portal.

formId.label: HubSpot Form ID
formId.help: Paste the HubSpot form GUID (found in the form's Share/embed code, e.g. 7cb26a0c-a8cd-4edc-8f5a-21ea5525e0f5).

gradientBackground.label: Red gradient background
gradientBackground.help: Use the diagonal red-to-black brand gradient instead of the solid near-black surface.
